conviction_themes: New AI hardware form factors beyond wearables/pendants are the right bet — Midjourney is explicitly not building a pendant or simple wearable
AI-native hardware must be deeply integrated with generative AI models, not bolt-on
Spatial computing and hand-tracking experience (from Leap Motion and Vision Pro) are foundational to next-gen AI interfaces
previous_experiences: Hardware Engineering Manager and System EE Tech Lead for Apple Vision Pro, leading development of the spatial computing headset for ~5 years
Member of Technical Staff (Hardware Design) at Neuralink for ~9 months
Principal Hardware Engineer at Leap Motion (hand-tracking startup founded by Midjourney's David Holz) for ~4 years
Senior Embedded Systems Engineer at MRA Digital, focused on wireless video and near-to-eye electronics
Joined Midjourney as Head of Hardware in December 2023 to lead its new hardware division
bio_text: Ahmad Abbas is a veteran hardware engineer who led development of Apple's Vision Pro as Hardware Engineering Manager, and previously built hand-tracking hardware at Leap Motion alongside Midjourney founder David Holz. He joined Midjourney in December 2023 as Head of Hardware, tasked with pioneering a new category of AI-native hardware devices — likely a novel form factor distinct from existing AI wearables or pendants.
